measurement_scope: Exact same-source D->L->L->D 512/128 comparison of dedicated versus 21 independent 768-row owner slots, followed by a committed-source production checkpoint; one discarded warmup plus three runs/leg, cached builds, BF16 KV, and 10-ms whole-GTT.

hardware.system: Framework Desktop / AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395

implementation.algorithm: unchanged SH-M2 conservative route/stage interval map with 21 independently allocated owner slots
implementation.dedicated_fallback: F32/capture diagnostics, unvalidated routes, unvalidated backends, and capability denial retain dedicated buffers
implementation.comparison_seam: external /tmp wrapper changes only the imported backend capability between 4096 and 768; no runtime env/branch is added

protocol.prefill: forced bulk WMMA, bulk attention, five explicit q4096 controls resolving right-sized scratch capacity 768
protocol.decode: production GEMV eager, one warmup token and 128 measured transitions
protocol.build: precomputed hipcc version plus require_cached_build; no compiler in measured process
protocol.correctness: dedicated versus owner-slot byte fingerprints after prefill and four fixed-input transitions
